_readme: Single source of truth for testnet external dependencies. 'verifiedOnChain' blocks are written ONLY by contracts/scripts/testnet/verify-addresses.js - never edit by hand. 'source' is where the value was read from; an on-chain check is still required.

pyth.notes: Docs list 3 contracts for Arbitrum Sepolia: Pyth Core 0x4374..., Pyth Core Compatible 0x0B73614636C855Bf23F342F307FB981A3e47f42B, Pyth Pro 0xACeA761c27A909d4D3895128EBe6370FDE2dF481. Only Core answered getPriceUnsafe for all 3 feeds when probed read-only; the others reverted. Hermes channel (stable vs beta) for testnet pushes is UNVERIFIED.

oracle.notes: MedianOracle reverts if either source is older than medianMaxAgeSecs. Pyth is pull: it is stale unless something pushes updates (see TESTNET_RUNBOOK). Chainlink testnet heartbeats: BTC/ETH 120s, SOL 86400s per Chainlink's directory, hence the generous 3600s. The same bytes32 (Pyth feed id) is the market feed key in BOTH adapters.
oracle.modeRule: ORACLE_MODE env overrides. Default 'median' (Chainlink + Pyth through MedianOracle, both sources must be fresh) ONLY IF verify-addresses.js reports every Pyth feed fresh (age <= pythFreshSecs) AND a Pyth pusher is running; otherwise 'chainlink' (ChainlinkAdapter is the exchange oracle directly, Pyth is not used). verify-addresses.js prints the recommendation; the config default stays 'chainlink' until Pyth is observed fresh.

chainlinkGapMeasurement.method: read-only getRoundData over the last 25 rounds of each feed via the public Arbitrum Sepolia RPC (no key, no tx)
chainlinkGapMeasurement.rule: market maxAge >= p95 gap with margin (we use >= 1.3x the worst observed gap, rounded): BTC 600 (4x p95), ETH 600 (10x p95), SOL 14400 (1.36x the max 10591 and 1.8x p95; the SOL testnet feed updates on a 24h heartbeat/deviation and is bursty). A longer maxAge weakens staleness protection; on mainnet use the feed's real heartbeat.

differencesFromLocalDeployJs: maxOrderSize/maxOI reduced ~10000x (sizes in 1e8 units: BTC 1 / 10 BTC, ETH 20 / 200, SOL 400 / 4000). Everything else (tick, lot, tiers, fees, band, funding) identical to scripts/deploy.js. Oracle = ChainlinkAdapter (default) or MedianOracle(Chainlink, Pyth) instead of ManualOracle (plus RoutingOracle + ManualOracle for the optional DEMO-USD market); collateral = Circle test USDC instead of MockUSDC.

demo.label: DEMO - admin-set price, not a real feed
demo.note: Optional 4th market priced by a ManualOracle that only the deployer can move, routed by RoutingOracle. It exists so the backstop Phase 2 path (liquidation -> inventory -> Dutch auction) can be shown on testnet, because real Chainlink/Pyth prices cannot be moved on demand. Never treat its price as market data. Disable with DEMO_MARKET=no.

backstop._readme: Values for enable-backstop.js (setBackstopCfg: softNotional in micro-USDC, bounds maxDiscBps<=min(300,bandBps), ramp>=60, maxAge>=dwell+ramp). BTC-USD scaled from docs/RUNBOOKS.md 0b (soft = 2% of maxOI notional at ~65k = 13,000 USDC, maxDiscBps 100, dwell 60, ramp 600, maxAge 1800). DEMO-USD is tiny and fast on purpose so it can be watched within minutes.
